text:
olivia: quick heads-up — I ran the link-checker against /handbook and found three internal 404s inside onboarding.md. small fix + redirect suggested, looking for a volunteer to open a tiny PR.

raj: thanks. can you paste the broken URLs and your suggested replacements?

olivia: sure. failing ones I saw: 
- /docs/runbook -> /runbooks/infra-recovery
- /assets/diagrams/infra-v1.png -> /assets/diagrams/infra-v2.png
- /quickstarts/getting-started -> /handbook/onboarding/quickstart

Also created a branch and a draft PR for visibility: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234

olivia: quick commands I ran locally to prepare the patch:
```bash
# replace old runbook link with new runbook path in markdown files
rg \"\\(/docs/runbook\\)\" -l | xargs sed -i \"s|/docs/runbook|/runbooks/infra-recovery|g\"
# update image filename references
rg \"infra-v1.png\" -l | xargs sed -i \"s|infra-v1.png|infra-v2.png|g\"
```

marta: I can take this tomorrow morning. i'll claim the PR and push a tiny commit to fix the three links. :+1:

ben: heads-up — staging CDN caches old asset paths for up to 1h. when the PR merges ping me and i'll invalidate during the 16:00 PT deploy window.

docs-bot: link-checker job completed: 3 broken links found in /handbook/onboarding.md

olivia: awesome, thanks @marta and @ben. @marta please request review from @olivia and @raj after you push. @ben i'll ping you right after merge so you can invalidate.

marta: claimed and pushed patch to branch olivia/docfix/onboarding-link-fix. opened PR and marked WIP: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234

raj: quick review note — looks fine from my side, please include a short changelog line in the PR body for audit.

ben: noted — will invalidate CDN after merge, target 16:15 PT.

olivia: thank you all. i'll follow up post-merge and close the loop in the handbook.
